summary: Frontend-only regression pass after SEO/performance/lazy-route/webp changes. All 13 public pages load via lazy+Suspense without blank screens; hero and images render from /assets/*.webp. Anonymous homepage triggers zero /api/auth/me requests and no 401s. Desktop testimonial carousel (testimonials-desktop) with dots testimonial-page-dot-0/1 clickable. Mobile (390x844) shows all 8 dots testimonial-dot-0..7 clickable; both Call Us and Book Trial (->/contact) visible. Admin login (admin@usgoldgym.com) redirects to /admin, dashboard loads, page reload persists session, logout redirects to /login and /admin becomes protected again. Contact form submits and shows 'Message sent!' toast. Static SEO files: /robots.txt (text/plain, contains User-agent: *), /sitemap.xml (application/xml urlset), /llms.txt (text/plain, H1 present) all return 200.

issues: File begins with a large Cloudflare-managed comment block before the first 'User-agent: *' directive. Still valid robots.txt (crawlers ignore comments), but if strict tooling expects the first non-blank line to be a directive it may flag it. Not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: robots.txt has ~30 lines of legal/Cloudflare boilerplate comments preceding directives; consider trimming for cleanliness (non-blocking).
Lazy routing + Suspense confirmed working across all 13 public routes with no visible fallback flash issues.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ contact form submission via /contact (name=TEST_Playwright, email=test_pw@example.com).
context_for_next_testing_agent: SEO/perf refactor (React.lazy + Suspense, webp assets, AuthContext usg_session flag gating /auth/me, larger tap-target dot buttons in testimonial carousels) verified regression-free. All static SEO files served correctly by CRA dev server.
